issues.body: The diff adds both Store.validateStore and store_validateStore to the generated declaration file, but adds no corresponding Rust/wasm implementation or generated JavaScript glue. No validateStore or validate_store implementation exists elsewhere in the checkout. TypeScript callers will compile successfully and then encounter a missing method/export at runtime. This is the same unsupported API class that was absent in round 3.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the validateStore documentation, method declaration, cross-link, and InitOutput export from this PR. If the API is intended, implement it in the wasm source with focused stateful/default-graph equivalence tests, update the public JS/WASM skill as required, and regenerate all wasm-bindgen artifacts rather than editing only the .d.ts file.
issues.title: Generated typings declare validateStore without a runtime implementation

verdict.summary: Round 4 regresses from round 3's clean approval: the unsupported Store.validateStore declaration has returned in the generated wasm typings, but this diff contains no corresponding wasm implementation or generated JavaScript binding. Repository context also contains no validateStore/validate_store implementation outside this declaration file. Consumers can therefore compile against an API that is absent at runtime, and the claimed low-level wasm export is likewise unsupported. The file-picker refactor and its focused tests remain coherent, but the false generated API surface is a major blocking issue.
